headword: {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け
gloss: for beginners; aimed at beginner learners

definitions.gloss: for beginners; intended for beginner learners; entry-level
definitions.explanation: Designed for or aimed at beginners — people who are just starting to learn a skill or subject. Seen as a label on textbooks, classes, apps, tutorials, and equipment. Contrasted with {上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}け (for advanced users).

examples.japanese: {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}けの{教材|きょうざい}。
このアプリは{初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}けです。
examples.english: This app is aimed at beginners.

examples.japanese: {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}けの{本|ほん}から{始|はじ}めると、{挫折|ざせつ}しにくい。
examples.english: Starting with a book for beginners makes it less likely you'll give up.

examples.japanese: {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}けの{説明|せつめい}は{丁寧|ていねい}だが、ある{程度|ていど}{慣|な}れると{物足|ものた}りなく{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: Beginner-level explanations are thorough, but once you get used to it you may find them lacking.

notes:
Composed of {初級者|しょきゅうしゃ} (beginner, elementary learner) and the suffix ～{向|む}け (aimed at, intended for, targeted at). The suffix ～{向|む}け attaches to a noun referring to a group of people and forms a noun or modifier meaning "intended for [that group]."

USAGE:
- As a の-modifier: {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}けのクラス (a beginner-level class)
- As a predicate: この{本|ほん}は{初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}けです (This book is for beginners)
- Common on language textbooks, music tutorials, cooking recipes, fitness programs, and game difficulty labels

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}けの{本|ほん}: a book for beginners
- {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}けコース: a beginner course
- {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}けの{説明|せつめい}: a beginner-friendly explanation
- {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}けに{書|か}かれた: written for beginners

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}け: for advanced users — the direct antonym
- {中級者向|ちゅうきゅうしゃむ}け: for intermediate learners — the middle level
- {初心者向|しょしんしゃむ}け: for newcomers / complete beginners — a near-synonym; {初心者|しょしんしゃ} nuances someone with no experience at all
- {入門|にゅうもん}: introduction, entry — used as a prefix in titles, e.g., {入門|にゅうもん}{書|しょ} (introductory book)
